profiles.Summary: HELLDIVERS 2 is a demanding third-person shooter whose PC minimum GPU (GTX 1050 Ti) matches the Steam Deck's GPU class, meaning playable frame rates are achievable but require low settings and FSR upscaling to stay stable. Expect roughly 30–40 fps in most gameplay scenarios, with drops during heavy combat and large-scale explosions.

MaxBattery.Notes: Rendering at 960x600 with FSR upscaling to 1280x800 keeps the GPU load manageable; the 9 W TDP cap and locked 30 fps prevent thermal spikes and stretch battery life. Note that in-game option names are estimated from typical Unreal Engine 5 titles — verify them in the graphics menu on first launch.

Some users report crashes or freezes on Proton; GE-Proton has been reported to improve stability in similar titles.
